result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by eliminating the Licensor’s unilateral seven-year option, requiring mutual written agreement for successive 12-month renewals, and capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. The revision is targeted and leaves unrelated termination rights unchanged. Drafting quality is reduced by redundancy with Sections II and III, the uncorrected phrase “mutual written of the parties,” and the failure to specify the applicable CPI index and measurement methodology.
